The next map milestone

Connecting every entry.

2533 of 2545 directory entries have a sourced regional connection. 12 await supported regional connections. Every region shown on the map can be opened. The gaps below describe the evidence still needed for particular entries. This tracks access points, including related names and umbrella labels, rather than counting distinct nations.

Each region link reflects a place or period supported by the cited source. One directory entry can appear in several regions.

← Interactive map · Entries awaiting connections
